mapper.select: SELECT f.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_name, h.house_title as house_title, h.house_address as house_address, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.house_images, '$[0]')) as house_images, h.house_price as house_price, h.house_type as house_type, h.house_area as house_area FROM h_favorite f LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON f.house_id = h.house_id WHERE f.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY f.favorite_create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_favorite WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND house_id = #{houseId}
